responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes
Develop interactive dashboards and BI reports to visualize complex data sets
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver tailored analytics solutions
Optimize database performance and ensure high data quality standards
Document technical specifications, workflows, and best practices
Support cross-functional teams with ad hoc data analysis needs

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Optimize database performance and ensure high data quality standards
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour: the JD carries quality signals ("ensure high data quality standards", "attention to detail", "best practices") with no velocity vocabulary at all — "dynamic team" in the closing CTA is not a delivery-speed signal.
evidence.domain_risk: transforming data into actionable insights that empower decision-making across the organization
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Moderate: errors would affect business decisions, and there is no financial-reporting, audit, or regulatory language anywhere in the posting.
evidence.collaboration_width: No distinctly named partner teams — only generic groupings: "business stakeholders"; "cross-functional teams"; "technical and non-technical audiences".
evidence.data_team_maturity: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid: "maintain scalable data pipelines" and "join our team" imply existing infrastructure and an existing team, with no greenfield or first-hire language and no mature-scale sub-team structure; the BI tools appear only in requirements, so they are not a maturity signal.
evidence.jd_authorship: Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver tailored analytics solutions
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Recruiter: every responsibility bullet is interchangeable boilerplate — no tool named in the responsibilities, no scale or volume figure, no methodology — so the reader cannot tell what this person does on a Tuesday morning.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver tailored analytics solutions
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Mixed: the audience is the whole organisation — "business stakeholders", "cross-functional teams" and "technical and non-technical audiences" — with no single function (commercial, product, finance or the data team itself) named or weighted above the others.
evidence.autonomy_level: Support cross-functional teams with ad hoc data analysis needs
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Execution: the one strategic verb, "drive the development", sits in the recruiter summary, while all six responsibility bullets are delivery verbs — design, develop, collaborate, optimize, document, support.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: None: AI, ML and coding assistants are absent from the whole posting, responsibilities and requirements alike.
evidence.testing_framing: Optimize database performance and ensure high data quality standards
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: data quality is framed as something the candidate ensures, using an ownership verb inside a responsibility bullet, rather than a testing tool sitting in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: a single data-quality clause in an otherwise delivery-framed JD — the fear is bad data, not regulatory exposure or lost stakeholder trust.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mixed: build verbs ("Design, build", "Develop interactive dashboards") sit alongside maintenance and tuning verbs ("maintain", "Optimize database performance") with neither dominant.
evidence.loss_aversion: "Optimize database performance and ensure high data quality standards" — the only risk-reduction framing in the posting, and it is operational rather than compliance-driven.
evidence.posting_anomaly: Agency/staffing posting: Rapsys Technologies Pte Ltd. is a Singapore recruitment and staffing firm ("What started as a specialist recruitment firm quickly grew into a full-service talent and staffing platform"), so "join our team" refers to a placement, and the end client is not named. The TapTalent payload also carries a recruiter-side "criterionDetails" screening block naming AWS, Amazon Redshift, S3, AWS Glue and QuickSight; that is internal filter data, not candidate-facing JD copy, so it is excluded from jd_text and from the has_* stack flags.
